titulo: A book on the seat until you arrive
caption:
A book on the seat until you arrive

My coworker holds the seat next to hers with a book until I arrive. Then I started holding hers.

A seat held with a book says someone was expected, and that is often the warmest part of arriving.

For whoever keeps the next seat free.

Closer to yourself.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window and two chairs, a book resting on the chair on the right and an amber block figure with white eyes standing on the left. Its eyes go wide and it pulses as a sky blue figure walks in from the right. A bubble says it's yours. and the book drops to the floor. The blue one steps to the chair, its eyes turn happy and a bubble says you're the best. The text stays: me holding you a seat.
